newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends firm on strong cash market - Sept 24.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends firm on strong cash market - Sept 24.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mostly higher on firmness in the cash market and on commercial buying, traders said.
The December/March spread ended at a three-cent inverse after having started at a two-cent carry.
"There's the feeling that we needed to invert the spread to entice some cash selling," a trader said.

A glance at deliverable spring wheat stocks data released Wednesday showed supplies were tighter than last year. A total of 8.224 million bushels were in deliverable position in Duluth/Superior, down from 14.490 million last year.
MGE spring wheat closed one cent per bushel lower to 6-1/4 cents higher, with Dec up 6-1/4 cents at $4.19.

Traders said Atwood-Peavey bought two million Dec bushels. LFG bought one million March and sold one million Dec. CIS and Benson Quinn each bought one million Dec and Wilson sold two million Dec, traders said.
The MGE estimated Tuesday's spring wheat futures volume at 20.669 million bushels, versus 12.914 million on Monday.
MGE barley futures closed one to two cents per hundredweight lower, with Dec down one cent at $7.18.
